steps.purpose: Read Corvale General's approved interchanges for these items.

explanation.headline: FDA's records trace this shortage to a plant on our own labels

sentences.text: Corvale General has 256 units on hand at 15.6 units per day, providing 16 days of supply.
The product label identifies Northwind Health Company, LLC as the registered plant (FEI 1831143) with a VAI inspection on 2025-09-26.
FDA inspection 952157 classified the same facility (FEI 1831143, Northwind Pharmaceuticals LLC) as OAI with an end date of 2015-12-09.
Subsequent inspections in 2018 and 2025 returned VAI classifications.

rejected.text: That OAI classification occurred 3777 days before the posting date of 2026-10-21.

rejected.text: The recommended alternative is Proficient Rx LP, which is not on FDA's shortage list and whose plant last received a VAI inspection on 2022-12-08.

Q-c72109.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%valacyclovir%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%valacyclovir%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-5544ab.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('f98aea50-e4d9-c0cc-e053-6294a90a811c') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-3fa3fe.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%valacyclovir%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-e0bc13.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%valacyclovir%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-5b309f.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%valacyclovir%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%tablet%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-44461a.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('1831143', '3011895410', '3007373532', '3004021229', '3005796917', '3011557028') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-a956f9.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('1831143', '3011895410', '3007373532', '3004021229', '3005796917', '3011557028') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-089f4a.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1831143') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('northwind health')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-6fcbb0.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('northwind health') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%valacyclovir%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-4696e2.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('952157') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-1769ee.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('51655070304')

Q-f223bf.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%valacyclovir%'
